# UX Requirements Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate operator-facing UX and evidence-surface requirements without widening SPEC-010B into a dashboard redesign.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are operator-visible Product Line B inspection paths fully defined for seed verification, SQL/API/status evidence, and temporary smoke-enabled dashboard scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are disabled Product Line B switcher states specified after seed/apply, during explicit smoke enablement, and after final disablement? [Completeness, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Switcher Evidence]
- [ ] CHK003 Are operator-facing evidence packet phases complete enough for a reviewer to understand preflight, seed, enablement, smoke, disablement, cleanup, isolation, timing, redaction, and scope boundaries without replaying hidden setup assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are dashboard evidence requirements complete only for the existing Metric Cards, Task Flow, Task Pipeline, and triage totals when dashboard behavior or tests change? [Completeness, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Dashboard Evidence]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is disabled Product Line B absence from the normal switcher clearly defined as supporting disablement evidence, not the sole proof of disablement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Switcher Evidence]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the explicit smoke enablement window clearly bounded so Product Line B may appear in normal dashboard scope only during that operator-approved window? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications: Isolation Assertions]
- [ ] CHK007 Are required API/dashboard scope assertions tied to explicit Product Line A and Product Line B `workspace_id` values rather than ambiguous facility/global totals? [Clarity, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK008 Are runtime-inventory surfaces described clearly as optional read-only supporting evidence, not as a required operator journey or eligibility state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Parallel Safety]

## Scope And Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do UX requirements consistently avoid a new product-line metrics widget, include-disabled preview mode, or broad dashboard redesign? [Consistency, Spec §Reviewability Budget, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Dashboard Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Are dashboard and switcher assertions consistent with the plan's decision that no new UI journey is planned unless existing scoped evidence cannot express the proof? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK011 Are Product Line B operator surfaces consistent with Product Line A isolation requirements so expected Product Line B rows are not reported as Product Line A drift? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §SQL Evidence]
- [ ] CHK012 Are PR review packet UX/evidence requirements consistent with the requirement to identify files intentionally avoided for SPEC-014C safety? [Consistency, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Parallel Safety]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can a reviewer objectively determine whether Product Line B is inspectable while disabled without relying on the normal dashboard switcher? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Can dashboard scope evidence, when used, be objectively measured through the required `/api/status?action=dashboard&workspace_id=<id>` response paths? [Measurability, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK015 Can Product Line A dashboard metric parity be objectively evaluated without comparing only whole-database totals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §SQL Evidence]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the operator-recorded smoke checklist timing requirement be evaluated without making optional live GitHub UAT evidence part of the required UX gate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Quickstart §HAL UAT]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are operator-visible stop states covered for Product Line B residue, `plb-platform-*` conflicts, Product Line A isolation violations, incomplete disablement, and cleanup failure? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are invalid, unauthorized, or out-of-scope workspace selections specified with stable typed outcomes for scoped API evidence? [Coverage, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK019 Are optional live GitHub credential or permission failures represented as skipped/not-mutated evidence rather than blocking the required synthetic smoke review journey? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications: Synthetic Smoke And Evidence]
- [ ] CHK020 Are accessibility and real-browser evidence obligations scoped to actual user-facing UI changes, consistent with the constitution's Real UI Journey Quality Gate? [Coverage, Constitution §XIV, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [ ] CHK021 Are UX evidence requirements grounded in existing scoped read routes and existing dashboard surfaces rather than new API routes or UI components? [Dependency, Plan §Implementation Approach, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK022 Are assumptions about disabled Product Line B visibility explicitly documented so task generation cannot infer a hidden include-disabled switcher mode? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Switcher Evidence]

## Notes

- Focus areas: operator evidence surfaces, dashboard scope evidence, switcher visibility states, PR review packet traceability, and UI-change gates.
- Depth: Standard reviewer gate before task generation.
- Actor/timing: PR reviewer and task author before Phase 5 tasks.
